founder.name: Hassan Rashed Al Suwaidi
founder.title: Founder & General Manager
founder.bio1: Hassan Rashed Al Suwaidi is the Founder and General Manager of Altiva Real Estate, leading its vision to build a trusted investment bridge connecting GCC investors with the UAE real estate market, with a special focus on serving investors from Kuwait.
founder.bio2: His vision is grounded in the firm belief that successful real estate investment does not start with presenting properties, but with understanding the investor's goals, studying their needs, carefully analyzing the market, and then selecting opportunities capable of delivering real, sustainable long-term value.
founder.bio3: He has extensive experience managing several Kuwaiti companies operating in the UAE, contributing to tangible successes and building close professional relationships with leading Kuwaiti businessmen over nearly 24 years.
founder.bio4: Through Altiva Real Estate, he leads the company's expansion between Dubai and Kuwait, placing trust, professionalism, transparency, and quality of advice at the core of its work, with the goal of building long-term relationships with clients and partners and delivering an investment experience that lives up to their expectations.

qaisBio: Qais Ramadan specializes in business development, investment, and strategic partnerships. A graduate of Business Administration and Management Information Systems, he leads the exploration and development of commercial and investment opportunities at Altiva Group, building relationships with investors, companies, and decision-makers and turning them into actionable, scalable partnerships.

His experience in media and corporate communications gives him an integrated perspective on markets, institutional positioning, and relationship management. He works to strengthen commercial and investment ties between Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates and to identify promising opportunities that support Gulf economic integration.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: Altiva Real Estate is committed to protecting the privacy of our website visitors and clients. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our website or contact us.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.text: We may collect your name, phone number, email address, country of residence, and details about your real estate interest or service request, such as service type, emirate, property type and budget. You may optionally attach property-related documents or images. Please do not send bank details, passwords or highly sensitive documents. When you use the Smart Advisor, the conversation text may be processed to provide a relevant answer, so please do not share financial or sensitive personal information in the chat.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.text: We use your information and documents to process your service request, contact you, provide the requested advice or coordination, and improve our services. Website requests are recorded in Zoho for managed follow-up. Contact details entered in the Smart Advisor form are not sent to the ALTIVA team until you explicitly consent. We will not share your data with third parties without your consent, except with technical or professional providers needed to deliver the service or where required by law.

sections.title: Data Protection
sections.text: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.text: You may, at any time, request access to your data, request that it be updated, or request its deletion by contacting us via the email address shown on the Contact Us page.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.text: For any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at sales@altivaproperties.com.
